Definition: from G5228 and G1793; to intercede in behalf of:--make intercession for.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses hyperentynchánō where we would say to intercede for. In Romans 8:26, the text says "but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered."
TheologicalSignificance: In hyperentynchánō I find no hidden theology; it simply means to intercede for.
